feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 29 August 2026 8:16am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 29 August 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure centre lies in the North Sea, with another low centre moving eastwards across southern England today.


##Wind##

Variable 2 or 3, soon becoming east or northeast 2 to 4 through this morning and early afternoon. Then backing north or northwest 3 or 4 late afternoon and evening, and backing south or southwest tonight. Occasionally increasing 5 in the east of the area later in the night.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle spreading from the south today, clearing to isolated showers this evening or at first tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the east of the area at first, becoming south 3 to 5 by the afternoon. Gradually veering west overnight into Monday, then increasing 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the west of the area, late in the night.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then showers or longer spells of rain.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers or rain.
